'''Uukaablian''' was the native language of the [[Uukaablian]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Uukaablis]] in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. It seemed to be derived from a dialect of [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].
